unit.title: Fractions
unit.blurb: Halves, quarters and three quarters of shapes and amounts, and seeing that two quarters make a half.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Recognise ½, ¼ and ¾ of a shape.

O2.t: Find ½, ¼ and ¾ of a small amount and know that 2/4 = ½.

p: A **half** (½) is 1 of 2 equal parts. A **quarter** (¼) is 1 of 4 equal parts. **Three quarters** (¾) is 3 of 4 equal parts.
A shape cut into 4 parts of different sizes is not cut into quarters.

p: To find **¼ of 12**, share 12 into **4 equal groups**: 3 in each. So ¼ of 12 = 3. **¾ of 12** is 3 groups: 9.
A quarter is half of a half. Half of 20 is 10, and half of 10 is 5, so ¼ of 20 is 5.
